_comment: The colony's visible crowd (render/colonist_crowd.gd). Cosmetic: no game
rule reads any of this. Movement numbers are real seconds and tiles.
ART CONTRACT — drop a sheet at `sprite` and these numbers describe it:
* one row per facing, in this order (screen directions, not grid ones):
row 0 S    row 1 SE   row 2 E    row 3 NE
row 4 N    row 5 NW   row 6 W    row 7 SW
'S' faces the camera. Every row is drawn — nothing is mirrored.
* `walk_frames` frames per row, left to right, played at `fps`;
frame 0 is also the standing pose.
* `frame_size` is one cell of that grid, `anchor` the pixel inside it
the colonist stands on (feet, usually bottom-centre).
The shipped sheet is built from the per-direction GIFs in
cannot read animated GIFs, so drop new art there and re-run it.
With no sheet at all, a procedural placeholder figure is drawn instead.
